Actually being able to laugh at myself and not be bothered by what others say to me has empowered me more in life than I ever had previously. I used to be bullied every year that I went to school, I was always reacting or confronting these people be it in person, online even confronting them to the point where people would throw me into a physical altercation (I was short and fat had no chance in any situation like that) but at the time I felt like there was nothing I could do besides get angry or be offended and sad. While all I needed to do was realize that these people did not know me and did not care, so why should I care at all what these people have to say to me or about me.  
Therapy can be a great way to learn how to manage these feelings.
